newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 300 MW Tues peak firm power for NW only.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 300 MW Tues peak firm power for NW only.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 300 megawatts (MW) of peak firm power for Tuesday delivery to the Northwest only at $17.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Monday.
BPA also offered 39 MW of peak firm power at $17.00 per MWh for delivery within the Northwest or at the Nevada-Oregon border.
300 MW of non-firm power was offered during hours ending 0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PDT at $12.00 for Northwest sales and $13.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
For today, BPA had offered 400 MW of peak firm power at $18.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and $20.00 for COB.
